scope: C Hematology / Immunity / Infection first-learning cognition, learner order, local closure and progressive compression only
rule: Organize stable Current medical objects for learning without changing medical meaning, filling Source gaps, duplicating neighboring owners, inferring Question→Knowledge relations, or manufacturing learner progress.

normal_first_pass: KianOS bounded Block orientation and stop-line; LG map may orient but must not duplicate Lecture detail
continuous original Lecture contact for the whole Block or the Block Core's explicit natural Source unit(s) in iPad/MarginNote
one normal return to KianOS after that continuous Source contact
active retrieval in accepted Logic-Group learner order
cognition-specific LG closure; continue to the next LG retrieval without reopening Lecture by default
after all LG closures: Block Recall
natural_source_unit_examples: H24 Unit A schistosomiasis then Unit B STI remain two continuous Source units without a KianOS bounce between every LG
H9/H11 may use a genuine Lecture section boundary when the canonical Block itself marks one; LG count alone never creates a source break
surface_handoff_contract.lecture_attached_questions: remain on original Lecture/MarginNote; only meaningful Wrong/Uncertain evidence needs durable routing

negative_space: no complete clinical infectious-disease / antimicrobial / vaccine curriculum
no second Primary for normal hemostasis, RBC metabolism, iron/B12/folate, tumor-molecular foundation or organ-specific infection
no learner-state or mastery claim from repository construction
no downstream Projection schema allowed to rewrite accepted Learning Logic

inputs: A1 circulation: normal hemostasis, thrombosis/DIC consequences, perfusion/shock
A2 respiratory: oxygen-delivery boundary, pulmonary TB/opportunistic-infection interfaces, respiratory failure
A3 urinary: EPO/renal anemia, CKD bleeding, myeloma kidney, autoimmune/vasculitic renal injury, AKI
B digestive/metabolic/endocrine/tumor: iron/B12/folate, RBC metabolism, one-carbon/heme-bilirubin/nucleotide/tumor-molecular language
O9 tumor-general: clonal/tumor common language when canonical Blocks explicitly call the gate
outputs: D neuro/sensory/motor/orthopedics: CNS-infection pathology, B12 neurologic injury, vasculitic neuropathy, myeloma bone disease, RA joint destruction
E reproductive/breast: ABO/Rh, APS/pregnancy-loss, HIV/STI, maternal-fetal alloimmune interfaces
all Systems: CBC/Ret/marrow interpretation, anemia/bleeding/infection entry coordinates, immune/clonal evidence language
cross_system_handoff.fine_grain_rule: external System-level interfaces are allowed; external Block/KP routing fails closed unless a separate reviewed Current owner provides it

first_pass_chain: continuous Block / canonical Source-unit Lecture contact in MarginNote
active KP retrieval by accepted Logic-Group learner order
Logic Group closure without normal Source re-entry between LGs
after all Block LGs close: Block Recall
after all 27 Blocks actually learned: final System Reconstruction
later official question sweep only when learner state reaches that stage

system_route.flex_rule: A Block may move earlier when its true hard prerequisites are satisfied and source continuity benefits; learner order changes no medical identity.

partial_system_reconstructions.target: lineage/function → production/maturation vs peripheral loss/destruction/distribution → MCV×Ret / hemostatic layer → next evidence
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: 能在陌生贫血、全血细胞减少、溶血或出血病例中先正确路由，再命名疾病。

partial_system_reconstructions.target: clone → lineage/maturation → morphology/cytochemistry/immunophenotype/genetics by role → organ/tissue output → danger/prognosis
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: 不从WBC、一个CD或一条染色体直接完成全部诊断。

partial_system_reconstructions.target: insufficient defense vs self-directed injury vs alloimmune direction → effector/target/time → syndrome/organ combination → evidence role → treatment role
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: 抗体必须作为筛查/特异/活动/器官关联证据进入综合征模型，而不是独立病名。

partial_system_reconstructions.target: pathogen/exposure → site/source → host → tissue reaction/spread → source control → systemic danger
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: 能判断何时药物不能替代引流/清创/解除梗阻，并把器官特异诊疗返回真实owner。

final_system_reconstruction.target: production/update/readout → clonal evidence → immune direction → infection site/host/source-control → C failure modes / judgment axes
forbidden: treat default route as medical ontology

compression.first_pass: full required continuous original-Lecture contact at Block/natural-Source-unit granularity + LG retrieval/closure after normal Source contact
compression.second_pass: discrimination + decisive evidence roles + high-value precision + cases + real W/U repair
compression.late_review: branch/System causal skeleton + decisive boundaries + real weak points + fresh application
compression.memory_admission: selective evidence-driven; canonical KP existence alone creates no permanent review debt

projection_boundary.known_incompatibility: Current generic Xizong loader accepts only contiguous [start,end] logic ranges; C has intentional non-contiguous LG membership.
projection_boundary.rule: Projection must later support explicit membership without changing C Learning Logic.

fresh_audit_repair.red_point: LG retrieval partitions were incorrectly promoted into mandatory Source-contact partitions, causing normal LG-by-LG KianOS↔Lecture bouncing.
fresh_audit_repair.repair: Restore Block / canonical Source-unit continuous Lecture contact; run LG retrieval and closure after the normal Source contact; only explicit verification/visual/conflict/repair cases reopen Source.

self_adversarial_phase6a.resolved_challenge: H6 keeps ITP-first LG retrieval order because Block Orientation supplies the bleeding-localization coordinate before continuous Source contact and reordering the original Lecture would break Source continuity.

machine_semantics.jobs_compose: Group-specific goal/closure/continuity_rationale are authoritative. Generic job contracts describe reusable cognitive operators only and may not substitute for a local Logic-Group closure.

LOCALIZATION.goal: 先定位故障/证据/空间/owner，再命名疾病或动作。
LOCALIZATION.closure: 新情境中能给出第一定位与下一最小判别步骤。

CAUSAL_CHAIN.goal: 重建上游变化→中间机制→下游表型/证据。
CAUSAL_CHAIN.closure: 改变一个上游条件时能预测下游方向并解释原因。

EVIDENCE_STACK.goal: 区分各证据层回答的问题及其不可替代性。
EVIDENCE_STACK.closure: 新证据组合中能说明每层增量信息并拒绝单层包办诊断。

DISCRIMINATION.goal: 用决定性条件排开高频近邻而非背名单。
DISCRIMINATION.closure: 新情境中能指出最小判别条件并解释为何排除近邻。

DIRECTION_TIMING.goal: 明确谁作用于谁、方向和时相。
DIRECTION_TIMING.closure: 能重建攻击/输入对象与时间关系，避免方向性错误。

SYNDROME_ORGAN_MAP.goal: 从共同上游模型重建多器官/组织组合。
SYNDROME_ORGAN_MAP.closure: 新病例中能由器官组合反推共同上游并区分损害/活动。

SOURCE_CONTROL.goal: 把解剖持续源、压力/坏死/异物/梗阻与机械源控制相连。
SOURCE_CONTROL.closure: 能判断何时药物不能替代引流/清创/解除梗阻。

URGENT_PARALLEL_ACTION.goal: 识别当前危险并并行推进不能互相替代的动作线。
URGENT_PARALLEL_ACTION.closure: 能指出不能等待的危险出口及必须同步执行的动作。

URGENT_RECOGNITION.goal: 从高/低极端或空间危险信号识别需要立即升级的状态。
URGENT_RECOGNITION.closure: 能在非典型表现下仍识别危险，不被单一常见信号绑架。

PRECISION_CLUSTER.goal: 只保留会改变306判断的Current Source精度。
PRECISION_CLUSTER.closure: 仅在题干需要时恢复精度，并能说明其适用边界。

VISUAL_RECOGNITION.goal: 把形态/图像挂回机制、空间或证据角色。
VISUAL_RECOGNITION.closure: 能由形态反推病理过程而非只认图名。

BOUNDARY_RECALL.closure: 能明确何处必须停止扩写并返回原Source/真实owner。

CONNECTION.goal: 只建立必要跨owner接口，不转移Primary ownership。
CONNECTION.closure: 能把接口接回真实owner且不复制完整模型。

RECOGNITION.goal: 用组合高信号识别模式而非单点标签。
RECOGNITION.closure: 能从组合线索识别方向并指出仍需的确认层。

DECISION_LOCALIZATION.goal: 按当前问题把判断落到下一检查/治疗角色/行动层。
DECISION_LOCALIZATION.closure: 能从状态选择下一角色或动作，并说明替代关系为何不成立。

machine_semantics.receipt_role: construction evidence only; this JSON is the single machine Learning candidate owner

storage.rule: This manifest plus the listed block shards is one Learning owner. Shards are transport/storage only and do not create parallel semantic ownership.
